about: Website notes for /docs/cli/. Keys are a command path, a command path plus an argument, or 'env NAME'. A note fills in where the engineering help text is empty and is appended where it is not. null keeps an environment variable off the page. The build fails if a key matches nothing in interfaces.json, or if a command, argument or variable ends up with no text.

notes.common groups list: List groups, their members and their policies
notes.common models inspect target: A model id, or a path to a .gguf file
notes.common run --device: Where to run: pick automatically, the CPU or the GPU
notes.common chat --device: Where to run: pick automatically, the CPU or the GPU
notes.common serve --host: Address the HTTP API listens on; must be an IP address
notes.common bench --device: Where to run: pick automatically, the CPU or the GPU
notes.common peers join target: The pairing address `ip:port` the other device shows, or its QR payload
notes.common peers join code: The 6-digit code; not needed with a QR payload
notes.common peers rm id: Device id, short label such as `ab12-cd34-ef56`, or a unique prefix
notes.common peers revoke id: Device id, short label such as `ab12-cd34-ef56`, or a unique prefix
notes.common groups create --allow-pooled: Pooling one model across devices is planned and not built; nothing uses this yet
notes.common groups add peer: A paired device: id, short label or unique prefix
notes.common groups remove peer: A member of the group: id, short label or unique prefix
notes.common groups policy --allow-remote: Members may run whole requests on this device
notes.common groups policy --allow-pooled: Members may host or use layer ranges. Pooling one model across devices is planned and not built; nothing uses this yet
notes.env COMMON_HOME: Use this data folder instead of the default
notes.env COMMON_MDNS: Set to 0 to turn off mDNS advertising and discovery
notes.env COMMON_API_KEY: Key the CLI's peer and group commands use to reach a key-protected daemon
